zh.eyebrow: 客户项目 · 拆包上料
zh.title: SCH100 机器人拆包上料案例
zh.subtitle: 客户定制地轨方案
zh.summary: 本项目采用 SCH100 机器人，结合客户定制地轨、专用袋装夹具及拆包投料工位，将袋装原料的抓取、转运、拆包投料与包装袋移送衔接起来。
zh.configurationNote: 视频展示的是客户定制地轨方案。SCH100 标准配置不带地轨；本项目地轨按客户现场需求配置。
zh.backgroundTitle: 围绕袋装原料上料流程组织作业
zh.background: 在该现场，原料袋堆放区与拆包投料工位沿设备布置。机器人从料垛上方取袋，将原料袋转运到投料工位，并在投料后移送包装袋。项目将机器人本体、移动地轨、专用夹具及投料工位组合为一套袋料处理单元。

steps.title: 从料垛取袋
steps.text: 机器人移动至取料位置，末端夹具接触原料袋，并从堆放区域提起袋料。
steps.alt: SCH100 专用夹具在原料袋堆放区取袋

steps.title: 转运至投料工位
steps.text: 机器人通过升降、回转与地轨移动的配合，将原料袋送至拆包投料区域。
steps.alt: SCH100 抓持原料袋并转运至拆包投料区域

steps.title: 拆包与投料
steps.text: 原料袋在拆包投料工位完成开袋与排料，袋内物料进入下方接料单元。
steps.alt: SCH100 在接料单元上方执行袋装原料投料

steps.title: 移送包装袋
steps.text: 投料后，机器人将包装袋移至旁侧接收位置，衔接后续包装袋收集。
steps.alt: SCH100 将投料后的包装袋移至旁侧接收位置

features: SCH100 负责袋料的抓取、提升与工位间转运。
客户定制地轨与机器人配合，覆盖现场取袋与投料作业位置。
专用袋装夹具配合拆包投料工位，衔接袋料搬运与上料。
投料后继续移送包装袋，使原料上料与包装袋处理形成连续流程。
zh.ctaTitle: 需要类似的拆包上料方案？
zh.ctaText: 请提供袋子尺寸、材质与单袋重量，料垛和投料口位置，目标处理量及现场布局。我们可据此评估 SCH100 的适配性，以及是否需要地轨等项目定制配置。
zh.seoTitle: SCH100 机器人拆包上料案例｜定制地轨方案 | SCR Robot
zh.seoDescription: 查看 SCH100 机器人拆包上料现场案例：从料垛抓袋、转运、拆包投料到包装袋移送。视频为客户定制地轨配置，SCH100 标准配置不带地轨。

en.eyebrow: Customer project · Bag opening and feeding
en.title: SCH100 Robotic Bag Opening and Feeding
en.subtitle: A customer-specific linear track installation
en.summary: This project combines an SCH100 robot with a custom linear track, dedicated bag-handling tooling and a bag-opening station. The cell connects bag pickup, transfer, material discharge and subsequent packaging-bag transfer.
en.configurationNote: The video shows a customer-specific installation with a linear track. The standard SCH100 configuration does not include a linear track. The track shown here was configured for this customer's site requirements.
en.backgroundTitle: Connecting bag storage with the feeding station
en.background: At this site, stacked bags are positioned alongside the bag-opening and feeding equipment. The robot picks up a bag from the stack, transfers it to the feeding station, and then moves the packaging bag to a separate receiving position. The project brings the robot, linear track, dedicated tooling and feeding station together as one bag-handling cell.

steps.title: Pick up a bag
steps.text: The robot moves to the pickup position. Its end-of-arm tooling engages the bag and lifts it from the stack.
steps.alt: SCH100 tooling engaging a bag at the stacked-bag pickup area

steps.title: Transfer to the station
steps.text: Vertical motion, rotation and linear-track travel bring the bag to the opening and feeding area.
steps.alt: SCH100 transferring a bag toward the bag-opening and feeding station

steps.title: Open and discharge
steps.text: The bag is opened and its contents are discharged into the receiving unit below.
steps.alt: SCH100 holding a bag above the material receiving unit

steps.title: Transfer the packaging bag
steps.text: After discharge, the robot moves the packaging bag to an adjacent receiving position for subsequent collection.
steps.alt: SCH100 moving the packaging bag to an adjacent receiving position

features: An SCH100 robot for bag pickup, lifting and transfer between operating positions.
A customer-specific linear track coordinated with the robot to cover the site's pickup and feeding positions.
Dedicated bag-handling tooling working with the bag-opening and feeding station.
Packaging-bag transfer after discharge, connecting material feeding with subsequent bag collection.
en.ctaTitle: Planning a similar bag-opening and feeding cell?
en.ctaText: Send bag dimensions, packaging material, unit weight, stack and inlet positions, target throughput and a site layout. These inputs help us assess SCH100 suitability and whether a linear track or other project-specific equipment is needed.
en.seoTitle: SCH100 Robotic Bag Opening & Feeding Case Study | SCR Robot
en.seoDescription: See SCH100 bag pickup, transfer, opening and feeding in a customer-specific cell. The linear track is custom equipment, not part of standard SCH100 supply.
